_comment: Generated by tools/extract.js from reference/mrcook (cross-checked against reference/ritchie .skool and .sna). Do not edit by hand.

conventions.grid: grid[row][col], row 0 = TOP of playfield (screen char row 3). Original stores rows bottom-up at $61A8; reversed here.
conventions.entityCoords: x = left pixel, y = TOP pixel of the 16x16 sprite in top-down screen coords. raw[] holds the original bytes: for spawn/duck raw y = sprite top measured up from the bottom (screenY = 191 - y); for hens raw y = feet line measured up from the bottom (screenY = 176 - y).
